criterion.standard: measures a life by whether Birth Of Niemoran is still remembered rightly
criterion.wasted_life: forgetting what Birth Of Niemoran actually meant, the way most people already have
criterion.trusts: a story that's been carried and retold and still holds together
criterion.distrusts: a record that insists on a precision no one who was actually there ever needed
